howto: Pick a level band on the title screen
Start the round and answer with taps/typing
Use Hint when you are stuck to learn the pattern
tips: Say the word/problem out loud before answering
Use hints early to learn patterns, not after guesses run out
Watch your streak and protect lives by choosing accuracy first

controls.keyboard: Type letters or numbers where supported; Enter submits in text rounds.
controls.touch: Tap buttons, letters, answers or lanes to play each round.

difficulty: Level bands are selected from the start screen and unlock harder ranges as progress grows.

features.learning hints: Available from Arcade hint action (and in-game hint buttons where present).
features.progress: Best scores and learning progress are saved in localStorage.
features.results: End screen shows score plus best and replay shortcut.
